verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Zapier exposing itself as an MCP server that external AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) connect to (e.g., zapier-docs-6, zapier-docs-11, zapier-docs-25, zapier-docs-28) — the reverse direction of the story. There is no evidence that Zapier itself can ingest or 'plug in' third-party MCP servers so that Zapier's own agents/workflows can consume their tools.
